title: Chapter 470 The City Lord’S Son Seeking Death
content:
Chapter 470 The City Lord’S Son Seeking Death

Walking on the street, the crowds around him were of all kinds and looked very tough.

The street vendors were shouting and hawking one after another.

Wang Shuo took a look and basically sold various materials and herbs.

Wang Shuo wandered around for a while. Although it was novel, there was nothing that could arouse Wang Shuo's interest.

Wang Shuo found a teahouse at random, ordered a pot of tea, and listened to the storyteller telling anecdotes between various empires.

At this time, what Wang Shuo was worried about still happened.

This group of dude boys still had a dispute with others.

Wang Shuo was on the second floor and saw the two sides fighting in the street.

Wang Shuo did not intend to take action. He had to teach this group of dude boys who were arrogant and incompetent a lesson.

Even if a few died, it didn't matter, so as not to cause trouble for himself in his own territory.

The dude boys all had their own bodyguards. Although they only had the strength of a mid-level general, they were also considered masters.

The local snake was beaten up, and Wang Shuo was a little bored and a little expectant. Beating the younger one led to the older one.

After a while, the local snake did not disappoint Wang Shuo.

Three intermediate generals appeared on the scene.

Wang Shuo was a little surprised. He didn't realize that there were intermediate generals here.

Wang Shuo has now begun to focus only on the king-level combat power. He doesn't take this intermediate general into consideration at all.

The dude was quickly dealt with.

Both sides were restrained and did not kill anyone in the city.

Just paid a large sum of money, and the matter was over.

Wang Shuo drank tea and watched the show. After both groups left, Wang Shuo got up and went back.

As soon as he returned to the inn, someone came to complain, saying that they were bullied.

Wang Shuo was secretly happy, it was what he deserved.

If you don't restrain your behavior, you will lose your life sooner or later.

But Wang Shuo didn't say these words.

"We are new here, let's not make any more trouble. We will leave tomorrow morning."

After Wang Shuo finished speaking, several people could only leave in disappointment.

The next morning, Wang Shuo wanted to leave with everyone, but when they arrived at the teleportation array, they were surrounded by the group of people from yesterday.

"Want to leave? No way."

A fat man with a big heart on the opposite side said arrogantly.

"It's not so easy to beat my brother."

Wang Shuo frowned and was a little angry.

In this world, there are really such "loyal" people, and they don't know how high the sky is and how thick the earth is, and their noses are up to the sky.

"What do you want?"

Seeing that Wang Shuo didn't stand up for them, the princes were a little scared.

"What do you want? Kneel down and apologize, and then each person will get 100,000 energy crystals."

This fat man is the son of the mayor of Sifang City. He heard about this from his brother yesterday. Seeing that the other party easily took out a large sum of money, he was also worried about having no money to spend, so he planned to blackmail him.

Wang Shuo was happy!

Well, I met a playboy again.

So, like attracts like, and with a few playboys, I always feel like I can meet playboys.

Wang Shuo was just planning to see how these princes were going to deal with this matter.

If it is handled properly, I don’t mind training a few heirs for the Ye family.

But among the group of people, no one stood up and took the initiative to take the lead.

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed. Although he didn’t say anything, isn’t it enough for me, the strongest king, to support you?

Wang Shuo shook his head and was about to show his trump card and let the other party get out.

But at this time, the son of the city lord began to commit suicide.
